image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary featuring a central altar. The altar is a raised structure covered in white cloth with a blue frontal panel, positioned beneath a large stained-glass window and flanked by floral arrangements. Wooden pews line the aisle in the foreground.
